nodes.title: Qualification & Needs
nodes.promptTemplate: What is your primary onboarding priority?

tagApplicationContract.rule: Tags must never be applied via raw unvalidated string inputs

riskTaxonomy.L0_READ: No side-effects, safe for automated agents without confirmation
riskTaxonomy.L1_INTERNAL_DRAFT: Drafts and proposals with no external side effects
riskTaxonomy.L2_STATE_MUTATION: Audited internal entity updates, workspace scoped, version-checked
riskTaxonomy.L3_EXTERNAL_COMMUNICATION_FINANCE: Outbound messaging, external webhooks, financial operations; agents need verified approval
riskTaxonomy.L4_PRIVILEGED_DESTRUCTIVE: Privileged or destructive; agents need verified approval, often non-delegable
